text:
maria_cs: Quick note from onboarding calls today — same set of asks showed up 3x. dropping raw signals here so we can triage quickly.

maria_cs: TL;DR: 1) per-route cost attribution (customers A+C) 2) toggle to disable auto-batching for low-latency routes 3) per-route embedding model choice (pilot wants control).

sam_pm: Important — who mentioned renewal risk? any high urgency? :eyes:

maria_cs: Acme Retail flagged cost visibility as a blocker for renewal (renewal in ~6w). GreenBridge pilot saw QA regressions after we flipped to quantized model, so they want a model pin per route.

kai_support: Logged a support note — customer reported ~40% latency spike when batching short chat messages. Quote: "Batching kills latency on our chat". They want an opt-out toggle per route.

li_devx: Can we get a quick sample of their short prompts? I can run perf + quality diffs across quant profiles. If someone can export ~200 short prompt examples I’ll start.

jon_eng: Engineering note — per-route model selection is doable but non-trivial: API + control-plane + rollout logic. Rough ballpark: 2-sprint effort to have safe defaults + rollout hooks. Opt-out for auto-batching is smaller (config flag + runtime check) — maybe a sprint.

sam_pm: Proposal for prioritization: 1) Opt-out toggle for batching (low effort, high impact for latency-sensitive pilots) 2) Per-route cost attribution visibility (medium effort, high ROI for renewals) 3) Per-route embedding model selection (higher effort, schedule later). Agree? :+1:

maria_cs: Agree. I'll surface this at tomorrow CS->Product sync and ask for a small spike for opt-out toggle this week.

maria_cs: Can someone pull event traces for acme-retail (org id: acme-retail) for last 30d — want token counts + per-request latency distribution.

triage-bot: @maria_cs created ticket CS-1429: "Acme: cost visibility + batching opt-out" and applied label renewal-risk.

kai_support: Attached two short logs from the call:
```
[2026-03-22T14:03:12Z] req_id=abc123 latency_ms=78 tokens=12 batching=on
[2026-03-22T14:03:13Z] req_id=abc124 latency_ms=420 tokens=9 batching=on
```

li_devx: I'll take the prompt export and run an eval tomorrow AM. tagging @jon_eng so we can align on runtime flag semantics.

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll include the customer quotes in the sync: "We can't explain why some requests bill more" and "Batching kills latency on our chat." If we can get the opt-out shipped quickly it might save the Acme renewal.

sam_pm: Sounds good. I'll prep a short prioritization note for product with impact estimate and link to CS-1429.

jon_eng: If we decide to ship opt-out, recommend default = preserve current behavior (batching on) and require explicit per-route opt-out to avoid regressions for other users.

maria_cs: Perfect — end of thread for now, I’ll post the sync notes after the meeting. :rocket:
